description:
pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:647:

    /// Globally unique, stable identifier for this lint.
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str;

The 'static lifetime forces every Lint impl to back its id with a
string literal or a Box::leak'd String. This is fine for the
20-ish hand-authored lints in this crate and pkix-lint-cabf.

It is NOT fine for the published goal of the workspace:
pkix-policy-zlint (PKIX-jy95) is supposed to adapt zlint's ~400
rules, each with an upstream-derived id. Those ids come from zlint's
NDJSON output at runtime. The current trait signature requires that
adapter to either:

  (a) Match zlint ids against a compile-time-baked HashMap<String,
      &'static str>, which means re-publishing pkix-policy-zlint
      every time zlint adds a rule.
  (b) Use Box::leak to permanently allocate every observed id.
      Memory grows unbounded for a long-running process if zlint's
      catalog evolves at runtime (it doesn't normally, but the API
      forces this trade).
  (c) Implement the trait on a Box<dyn Lint>-of-string-id wrapper,
      defeating the trait's purpose.

The same applies to:

  - title()  -> &str   — same lifetime story (less critical: tied to &self)
  - citation()  -> &'static str — same as id()
  - spec_section_id()  -> Option<&str>  — tied to &self, OK
  - spec_url()  -> Option<&str> — tied to &self, OK

# What the caller cannot do

A caller cannot write:

    struct ZlintBridgeLint {
        id: String,
        citation: String,
        ...
    }
    impl Lint for ZlintBridgeLint {
        fn id(&self) -> &'static str { &self.id }  // ERROR: lifetime mismatch
    }

They have to either leak or restructure. Every other trait method
(title, description, spec_section_id, spec_url) takes &self
correctly. Why is id() different?

# Suggested fix

Either change id() to `&self -> &str` (tied to &self lifetime — same
as title/description) or to `-> Cow<'static, str>`. Note:

  - Cow<'static, str> works for both static-string lints (zero-cost)
    and runtime-constructed lints (Cow::Owned).
  - Returning `&str` tied to &self is even cleaner; the only reason
    to require 'static is if the runner stores ids in `Finding`
    without copying. That copy is cheap and `Finding.lint_id` is
    already Cow<'static, str>.

# Provenance

The contract was set in 0.0.0 and locked through every minor since.
The recent migration of `LintResult` detail to `Cow<'static, str>`
(PKIX-ua6q, 0.3.0) was the analogue move for the *result* side; the
same move is overdue for the *id* side.

# Forward fit

When pkix-policy-zlint goes to PR, this trait restricts what the
adapter can do. Pre-1.0 framing: fix it before 1.0 ships. Breaking
change but free pre-1.0.
title: API contract: Lint::id() -> &'static str forbids runtime-built lint IDs
